question: The formula for calculating depreciation using straight line method is
solution:
Depreciation is the gradual loss of value of an asset due to use, age, or obsolescence.

The STRAIGHT-LINE method is the simplest way to calculate annual depreciation.

Formula: Depreciation = (Cost - Scrap/Salvage Value) ÷ Useful Life

Cost = Purchase price + additional costs to bring asset to use

Scrap/Salvage Value = Estimated value at the end of useful life

Useful Life = Number of years asset will be used

The correct answer is B. \( \frac{\text{Cost } - \text{Scrape Value}}{Useful life} \).
